capabilities: Create, convert, and edit inline and file-based tasks
Filter and view tasks in Table, Calendar, and Kanban surfaces
Schedule recurring tasks and deliver reminders
Track work with timers, sessions, and time history
Manage tasks from the terminal via CLI and agent runtime
extras: The manifest also advertises Gantt views and Canvas that the README does not detail. CLI, Developer API, and agent runtime features require Obsidian Desktop and a live Operon runtime. Full documentation (133 guides) is browsable at operon.cc/docs or downloadable into the vault as Markdown.
problem: Obsidian tasks are scattered across daily notes, project notes, and checklists without structured metadata, workflow views, or unified management as a vault grows.

relations.evidence: Convert a compatible Obsidian Tasks-style emoji line into an Operon inline task.
if the Maps plugin is installed, the Location picker's Map tab and location chip map previews use it

summary: Task management system that unifies inline and file-based tasks in Markdown with filters, tables, calendars, Kanban boards, recurrence, reminders, and time tracking.
